## Lustify SDXL API

Lustify SDXL is an image generation model by Community, available on the Venice API as `lustify-sdxl`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### Lustify SDXL API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lustify-sdxl` | Generate | Private | $0.01 / image |

### Lustify SDXL specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Community |
| Released | Feb 4, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Prompt limit | 1,500 characters |

### How to use the Lustify SDXL API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "lustify-sdxl"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "lustify-sdxl",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette"
  }'
```
